With a nonempty href the part renders a link. Otherwise it renders a button whose type defaults to "button". Set type to "submit" when you intend to submit a form.

## Usage

```ts
import { button, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/button';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/button`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

### Example View

Register the `button` set and pass this JSON as `view` to `renderer.mount`.

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "save",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Button",
    "inputs": {
      "text": "Save",
      "variant": "outline"
    }
  }
}
```

The View renders a button labeled “Save” with the outline variant.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-button"></a>

Slots `default`.

The [DOM events for this part](../../attributes/#dom-67a0f1612c) use a [direct payload](../../support/#event-payloads).

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.ButtonProps`, `components.ButtonSize`, `components.ButtonVariant`, `components.Props`.

- `components.buttonVariants` takes options `variant`, `size` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.
